newsitem.title: UK: Dixons hit by British budget moves on VAT.
newsitem.headline: Dixons hit by British budget moves on VAT.

text.p: Electricals retailer Dixons Group Plc saw its shares slide after after British Chanceller Kenneth Clarke on Tuesday introduced measures in his budget to make sure VAT is paid on extended warranties sold with products.
Dixons fell 23-1/2p to 547 as Clarke promised steps against retailers who cut their VAT bills by selling insurance with their products.

"It's a big blow to them," said Roy Maconochie, retail analyst at Henderson Crosthwaite. It depends whether Dixons absorbs the VAT or passes all or some of it on to consumers. "At the end of the day it will hit margins or sales," he said.
